dogecoin.text:
Being #British I always thought #Dogecoins #Dogecoin was a joke: '#Doge' can be pronounced "#Dodgy" & a Dodgy investment is exactly how I see it.
#ElonMusk's tweets & investments are "nickels & dimes" for him in reality.
He's most likely having a laugh!
@MaxKeiser @StacyHerbert

@PlanetPonzi @LawrenceLepard I always suspected there may have been something potentially "screwy" with #Dogecoin... being #British, I saw "#Doge" could naturally be pronounced as '#Dodgy'... there's the rub ;0)
